name: Cincinnati Wood Collaborative
old_description: We have been accredited by the BBB since 2018 and strive to maintain the principles of quality, value, and integrity, and to practice these principles in all our affairs.
about:
Cincinnati Wood Collaborative was founded in 2018 in Cincinnati, Ohio. The company operates as a local woodworking shop focused on custom projects for commercial and residential clients.

The shop provides custom woodworking for builds and renovations of any size, specializing in complete millwork packages for restaurants, bars, and breweries. Work is performed using sustainable, locally sourced wood from certified Master Logging Companies that meet Ohio Forestry Association standards, ensuring responsible forestry practices and proper timber harvesting techniques that maintain forest integrity.

Its primary customers are in the hospitality sector, including restaurant, bar, and brewery operators seeking custom millwork for new builds or renovations. The company also collaborates with other small businesses in the Cincinnati area, sourcing materials locally and fostering a community-oriented supply chain.

The business emphasizes responsible forestry practices and local sourcing, maintaining BBB accreditation since its founding year. Its approach centers on quality craftsmanship, value, and integrity, with a commitment to supporting the regional ecosystem and economy through sustainable material choices and local partnerships.
